The movie is a fast paced thriller showing the fun filled bromance between Rambo and Ranjha. It will surely take you on a thrill ride full of fun and joy.

1179112.ov: Plagued by depression and loneliness, a desperate young man seeks the one vice that may at least numb or distract him for a while. The Indian film High Fun (commonly known as 'Party and Play' or 'Chemsex' in the west) is a queer-themed horror film about living with your demons.
